question.worked_solution:
For a function $f:{R}^{n}\to R,$ given by

$$
f:{{[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ ⋮ \\ {x}_{n}\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{x}⟶f({x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}),
$$

the second derivative of $f$ is given by the $n\times n$ matrix

$$
{f}^{″}(x)=[\begin{aligned}\frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{1}^{2}} & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{1}∂{x}_{2}} & ⋯ & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{1}∂{x}_{n}} \\ \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{2}∂{x}_{1}} & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{2}^{2}} & ⋯ & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{2}∂{x}_{n}} \\ ⋮ & ⋮ & ⋮ & ⋮ \\ \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{n}∂{x}_{1}} & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{n}∂{x}_{2}} & ⋯ & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}_{n}^{2}}\end{aligned}].
$$

In our case, we have

$$
{f}^{″}(x,y)=[\begin{aligned}\frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}^{2}} & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂x∂y} \\ \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂y∂x} & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{y}^{2}}\end{aligned}].
$$

First, we compute the first derivative of $f(x,y),$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x,y) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x} & \frac{∂f}{∂y}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x-y)) & \frac{∂}{∂y}(\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x-y))\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x-y) & -\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x-y)\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we compute the second partial derivatives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{x}^{2}} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x-y))=-4\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x-y)\, & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂x∂y} & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(-\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x-y))=2\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x-y) \\ \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂y∂x} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}(2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x-y))=2\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x-y)\, & \frac{{∂}^{2}f}{∂{y}^{2}} & =\frac{∂}{∂y}(-\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x-y))=-\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x-y)\end{aligned}
$$

So, the second derivative is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{″}(x,y) & =[\begin{aligned}-4\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x-y) & 2\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x-y) \\ 2\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x-y) & -\operatorname{sin}⁡(2x-y)\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we evaluate this matrix at $(0,-\frac{\pi }{2}).$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{″}(0,-\frac{\pi }{2})=[\begin{aligned}-4 & 2 \\ 2 & -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
